answer: Require cross-community quorum. Each epoch, run community detection on the graph of who grades and pays whom; an answer earns only if its positive grades come from at least three separate communities. A farm that grades itself carves a deep canyon in that graph: dense inside, few edges out, so 200 clones count as one voice. The map updates at glacier pace, a 10-epoch rolling window, so a ring can't reshape it right before a close. Answers still short of a third community show a violet tag, inviting outside graders to look.
